Select distinct molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for compounds tested in assays against target CHEMBL1827. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1827'. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Return distinct rows sorted by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
